text: I suppose now I'll have to be an old maid, all on account of that feller Mason. When I think of how he used to come around and smoke my father's cigars, eat my mother's supper, and waste my life, I can't look my family in the face. I got so ridden for not liking him, and they're all the same. I could have married my elder butcher, Jake Diplomer,
